conventions.convention: The theorem works in ZF with \(\mathrm{AC}_\omega\); it uses Countable Choice only to select the independently specified near-norming vectors, not Dependent Choice or full Choice.
All spaces are over the common field \(\mathbb R\) or \(\mathbb C\); the theorem requires completeness of the domain \(X\), but not of the codomain \(Y\).

load_bearing.statement: Work in ZF and assume \(\mathrm{AC}_\omega\). Let \(X\) be Banach and \(Y\) normed over the same field. A pointwise bounded sequence of bounded linear maps \(T_k:X\to Y\) has a finite common bound on its operator norms.
For a bounded linear \(T:X\to Y\) and all \(x,u\in X\), \(\max\{\|T(x+u)\|,\|T(x-u)\|\}\ge\|Tu\|\).
